name: RZText::Utf8TrailCount(byte) (cdecl: the trail bytes after a UTF-8 lead byte, the old 2- to 6-byte forms; only the low byte counts)
notes: Lane VU (O-c). Cdecl, one argument; hooked at the RVA. 0xc2-0xdf 1, 0xe0-0xef 2, 0xf0-0xf7 3, 0xf8-0xfb 4, 0xfc-0xfd 5, else 0. Difftest RZTextTrail_Utf8 (8192 cases: every word 0-0x1ff, then seeded words; compared: the whole eax). Mutants (build/vu_mut3a.json, shared with the two below): 0xc2 not a lead, 0xfd not 5, 0xfe counted, the whole word compared: all killed.

name: RZText::CodePageTrailCount(byte, codePage) (cdecl: 1 for a double-byte lead in the code page, else 0)
notes: Lane VU (O-c). Cdecl, two arguments; hooked at the RVA. IsLeadByte (rz/RZTextChars.h, ours) answered as 1 or 0. Difftest RZTextTrail_CodePage (16824 cases: every word 0-0x2ff and seeded words against 18 code pages (932, 936, 949, 950, 1252, 0, 8, -1, -2, 65001, extremes) and seeded pages; the system code page preset to 1252 so the original never calls GetACP; compared: the whole eax). Mutant (build/vu_mut3a.json): a lead answers 2: killed.

name: RZText::TrailCount(byte, encoding) (cdecl: -2 the default and -1 the system code page resolved; UTF-8's trail count, a code page's from 100 up, else 0)
notes: Lane VU (O-c). Cdecl, two arguments; hooked at the RVA. Its caller cCanvasW32::OnChar 0x156260 (ours) now calls ours directly. Difftest RZTextTrail_ByEncoding (100944 cases: the code page test's cases under six system code pages, 1252, 932, 949, 8 (UTF-8), 0 and 950, preset in 0xff23a4; compared: the whole eax). Mutants (build/vu_mut3a.json): the default not resolved, the system code page not resolved, killed; code pages from 101 and the code page compare unsigned survived as equivalent (IsLeadByte answers only 932, 936, 949 and 950, so page 100 and negative pages give 0 on either branch).
